title: ONE BAG. THEY SAID ONE BAG.

shots.label: Hook

lines.text: Dash. I have one suitcase. One! Very reasonable. Very calm. Very me.
...Why is it shaped like a pyramid?

shots.dalle_scene: 3D animated Pixar-quality film style, original BootHop characters, premium cinema render, warm cinematic lighting, no text in image, large fluffy orange tabby cat named Bounce with vivid green eyes, AND small grey-blue mouse named Dash with big round grey ears and a travel bag, both standing in a cluttered London flat living room, Bounce proudly gesturing toward a wildly overstuffed suitcase that bulges in every direction and leans at a comedic angle, Dash staring at it with one eyebrow raised, bags and gift boxes and wrapped parcels stacked everywhere around them

shots.label: Problem

lines.text: It's just clothes. And Aunty Bisi's shea butter. And the biscuits she specifically said to bring. And a few—
Bounce. The scale says thirty-eight kilos.
The scale is lying and I won't hear otherwise.

shots.dalle_scene: 3D animated Pixar-quality film style, original BootHop characters, premium cinema render, warm cinematic lighting, no text in image, large fluffy orange tabby cat named Bounce with vivid green eyes, AND small grey-blue mouse named Dash with big round grey ears and a travel bag, Bounce standing on a bathroom scale next to his enormous suitcase looking horrified at the number, fur standing on end, green eyes wide with panic, Dash standing calmly nearby holding a small notepad with calculations on it, the suitcase visibly straining at its zips

shots.label: Tension / Chaos
shots.on_screen_text: Heathrow check-in. The moment of truth.

lines.text: Sir it's mostly air in there— soft air— culturally significant air—
The screen says sixty-five pounds. Per. Bag.
SIXTY FIVE? For LUGGAGE? They are taxing my AUNTY'S BISCUITS?!

shots.dalle_scene: 3D animated Pixar-quality film style, original BootHop characters, premium cinema render, warm cinematic lighting, no text in image, large fluffy orange tabby cat named Bounce with vivid green eyes, AND small grey-blue mouse named Dash with big round grey ears and a travel bag, at a busy airport check-in desk, Bounce leaning dramatically over the counter with claws out gesturing wildly at a baggage scale, fur puffed up in outrage, Dash standing a few steps back looking at his phone with a calm expression, bright overhead airport lighting, a long queue of passengers visible behind them looking bemused

shots.label: Idea

lines.text: Or... we could have sent Aunty Bisi's parcel ahead with BootHop. Cheaper than this fee. Arrives before you do.

shots.dalle_scene: 3D animated Pixar-quality film style, original BootHop characters, premium cinema render, warm cinematic lighting, no text in image, large fluffy orange tabby cat named Bounce with vivid green eyes, AND small grey-blue mouse named Dash with big round grey ears and a travel bag, Dash holding up his phone showing the BootHop website with a bright cheerful glow on his face, Bounce leaning in close with enormous curious green eyes reflecting the screen, the chaotic airport bustling in the background, a warm golden light emanating from the phone screen

shots.label: Realisation

lines.text: Book the courier, split the parcel off, and your bag drops under the limit. Done in two minutes.
I have been carrying shame in suitcase form my entire adult life and this was always the answer?!

shots.dalle_scene: 3D animated Pixar-quality film style, original BootHop characters, premium cinema render, warm cinematic lighting, no text in image, large fluffy orange tabby cat named Bounce with vivid green eyes, AND small grey-blue mouse named Dash with big round grey ears and a travel bag, both back at the check-in desk, the suitcase now sitting flat and slim on the scale showing a perfectly legal weight, Bounce covering his face with both large fluffy paws in a mix of relief and embarrassment, Dash tapping the confirm button on the BootHop app with a satisfied tiny smile, a green confirmation tick glowing on the screen

shots.label: Ending

lines.text: The biscuits will arrive before us. Aunty Bisi will never know.
She's going to ask why the tin is half empty.
I was nervous! Snacking is a coping mechanism!

shots.dalle_scene: 3D animated Pixar-quality film style, original BootHop characters, premium cinema render, warm cinematic lighting, no text in image, large fluffy orange tabby cat named Bounce with vivid green eyes, AND small grey-blue mouse named Dash with big round grey ears and a travel bag, walking through the departure gate together looking triumphant, Bounce holding a single sleek manageable suitcase and grinning broadly, Dash striding coolly beside him with his small travel bag, a warm sunset-orange glow flooding through the departure lounge windows, the BootHop logo glowing subtly on a screen in the background
shots.next_teaser: NEXT: Dash's 'small box' to Port Harcourt somehow ends up in Portugal — and Bounce is not helping.

caption: Sixty-five pounds per bag?! Bounce nearly left his dignity at Heathrow — until Dash found BootHop.com. Ship the gifts ahead, fly light, keep the peace. 🧳🐱🐭
setting: London flat → Heathrow Terminal departures → departure gate
story_summary: Bounce insists his one suitcase is perfectly reasonable — until it clocks in at thirty-eight kilos and the check-in screen flashes a £65 excess baggage fee. Full airport meltdown ensues. Dash quietly opens BootHop.com, books a parcel courier for Aunty Bisi's gifts, and the bag drops under the limit in minutes. They make their flight — though half the biscuits didn't survive Bounce's pre-boarding anxiety snack.
